r = gf.Component()

# Add splitter
splitter = r.add_ref(gf.components.mmi1x2())
splitter.move((0, 0))

# Add phase biasers
pb_i = r.add_ref(gf.components.straight_heater_metal(length=10))
pb_i.move((100, 50))

pb_q = r.add_ref(gf.components.straight_heater_metal(length=10))
pb_q.move((100, -50))

# Add MZMs
mzm_i = r.add_ref(gf.components.mzm())
mzm_i.move((200, 50))

mzm_q = r.add_ref(gf.components.mzm())

# Add combiner (mirrored MMI1x2)
combiner = r.add_ref(gf.components.mmi1x2())
combiner.mirror()
combiner.move((300, 0))

# Route connections
gf.routing.route_single(r, splitter.ports['o2'], pb_i.ports['o1'], cross_section='strip', radius=15)
